data.app_name: Cricket Frenzy Ultimate | Bat like a Pro
data.description:
Step into the ultimate virtual cricket experience with Cricket Frenzy Ultimate! Whether you're a seasoned cricket fan or a casual player, this game brings the thrill of the sport to life in stunning virtual reality.

🏏 Features:

One-Over Matches: Dive into exciting one-over matches that test your skills and reflexes.
Variety of Bowlers: Choose from a range of unique bowlers, each with their own style and difficulty.
Customizable Levels: Adjust gameplay settings to create tailored challenges that match your skill level.
Immersive Graphics: Enjoy high-quality visuals for a realistic cricketing experience.
Bat Selection: Unlock and play with a variety of bats, each offering different power dynamics.
Custom Ball Settings: Personalize your gameplay with unique ball options for added variety.
Game Modes: Explore Arcade Six Mode and Area Hit Mode for diverse gameplay challenges.
Dynamic Bat Mechanics: Experience variable bat power based on the bat you own.
Intuitive UI: Easily navigate menus, pause, and resume games with an enhanced UI.
Frequent Updates: New features and improvements added every 10 days to keep the game fresh and exciting.
🎉 Don’t miss out – enjoy it at low cost for a limited time! Download now, customize your gameplay, and get ready to dominate the pitch. Stay tuned for even more updates!

changelog.change_log:
Release Notes v0.7.1

Leaderboard UI Added: Now you can view and compare your scores with other players on the leaderboard.

Power-Based Shot Sound: Enjoy dynamic audio feedback based on the power of your shots for a more immersive experience.

Updated Ball Visuals: Improved ball textures and visuals for a sharper and more realistic look.

Reworked Hit Detection: Enhanced hit detection mechanics for the bat, ensuring more accurate and satisfying gameplay.

Crowd Toggle Option: Added an option to enable or disable the crowd for a customizable gameplay atmosphere.

Stay tuned for more exciting updates in future versions!

Release Notes (Version 0.7.0):

Improved the visual graphic quality across the entire game, enhancing the overall experience.
Added player data tracking, including high scores, sixes hit, and other stats, to be utilized in future updates.
Introduced five new bats to unlock and play with, each based on specific criteria.
Enhanced the UI flow, allowing players to pause or resume the game from the home icon while batting in any mode.
Updated the bat mechanics so the power of hits now varies based on the bat owned by the player.
These updates bring exciting new features and improvements for players to enjoy!

New Area: Hit Arcade section now available!
New Free Bat: Grab it and swing away.
Enhanced Gameplay: Enjoy a smoother and more refined experience.
Update now and dive in! 🎮🏏

- New Custom Ball options added.
Now the user can customize the ball type, speed and spin to play with.
- Some bugs have been fixed
- New feature placeholders for users.
